quote: This paper aims to unpack the coarse concept of misinformation and structurize it to fine-grained story types... We conduct this query through an empirical lens and ask the question: what are the prevalent types of misinformation stories in the US over the last ten years?

We choose binary precision Pr(z) to evaluate the quality of extracted rationales... Additionally, we measure the average percentage of selected rationales over the input length %(z). For predictions, we use macro F1(y) as the evaluation metric...
we choose bidirectional LSTM initialized with GloVe embeddings for the soft rationalization method.
the misinformation types we extract from our weakly supervised approach are not validated with ground-truth labels.
